Year by year

Takeaways

  • KO's operating margin fell from 26.7% in FY2021 to 21.2% in FY2024 before reaching 28.7% in FY2025, while PEP's stayed between 12.2% and 14.0%.
  • KO's net margin moved from 22.6% in FY2024 to 27.3% in FY2025; PEP's moved from 10.4% to 8.8% over the same year.
  • Gross margins were steadier than the lower lines: KO ranged from 58.1% to 61.6%, PEP from 53.0% to 54.6%.
  • KO's free cash flow went from $11.3B in FY2021 to $5.3B in FY2025, while PEP's went from $7.0B to $7.7B.
  • Diluted EPS rose from $2.25 to $3.04 at KO and from $5.49 to $6.00 at PEP, which peaked at $6.95 in FY2024; shares outstanding are about 4.3B versus 1.4B.

Not financial advice.

How the fiscal years line up and what is not reported

KO's fiscal year ends 12-31; PEP's ended 12-27 for the latest year. KO reports no R&D (n/r); PEP's R&D is 0.9% of revenue each year. Cash runway is n/m for both companies.
